description: This file defines the ConceptDatatype class, which is a custom datatype for handling Concept objects in the OpenMRS system. It provides methods to deserialize a Concept from its UUID and to generate a text summary for a Concept.

classes.name: ConceptDatatype
classes.description: A custom datatype class for handling Concept objects within the OpenMRS system, including deserialization from UUID and generating text summaries.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts a UUID string into a Concept object by fetching it from the ConceptService.

methods.name: doGetTextSummary
methods.description: Generates a plain text summary for a given Concept, using its name if available.
